cohort: The study included 138 late preterm infants admitted to the hospital, divided into an observation group with RDS (n=36) and a control group without RDS (n=102).
finding: Multivariate analysis identified male sex, elective cesarean section, amniotic fluid aspiration, premature rupture of membranes (PROM), and pregnancy complications as high-risk factors for RDS in late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean section was identified as a high-risk factor for RDS in late preterm infants.
